validity.recommendation: Keep the row. Real, correctly classified, uniquely mapped to Package 14 of Aramco MGS-3 (Shoaiba laterals). Optionally fill the Shoaiba endpoint (see fills).
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE (HIGH). P6734 is Package 14 of Aramco's Master Gas System Expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3), described identically by three independent sources: MEED ('Laying 56-inch, 16-inch and 10-inch lateral pipelines in the Shoaiba cluster, covering 212km', contractor Nesma & Partners / SICIM), the contractor SICIM's own site ('package 14 requires a total of 212 km of pipelines of various diameters to be laid in the Shoaiba area'), and BlackRidge Research (verifier confirms the page contains 'Shoaiba', '212', '56'). This is not a GEM-only entity; the segment is named and specced by the awardee contractor itself. CLASSIFICATION (HIGH, minor caveat). Aramco/MEED call Package 14 'lateral pipelines' in the Shoaiba cluster, i.e. laterals branching off the east-west MGS trunk to feed the Shoaiba demand centre (a major Red Sea power/desalination complex south of Jeddah). GEM records PipelineType=transmission. Defensible: these are part of the national gas transmission network delivering to a load centre (the 56-inch component is trunk-scale), NOT gathering from wellheads or in-plant process piping. Caveat only, not a reclassification. FuelSource Gas correct (natural/sales gas). ATTRIBUTION (HIGH). Owner Aramco 100% correct (MGS is Aramco's own system; Nesma/SICIM are EPC contractors, not owners). Country Saudi Arabia correct. DUPLICATE CHECK (clear). P6734 uniquely maps to Package 14 (212 km, 56/16/10-in, Shoaiba). It is NOT a duplicate of the other lateral rows: P6732=Pkg12 (116 km, 16/12/4-in), P6733=Pkg13 Riyadh laterals (470 km, 16/12/10/4-in), P6735=Pkg15 Yanbu-Rabigh (192 km, 20/16/12/4-in), P6736=Pkg16 Jeddah (52 km, 52-in), P6737=Pkg17 Jizan (30/16-in). Distinct length + diameter set + destination cluster; no double-count. SPEC. LengthKnown 212 km matches MEED, SICIM and BlackRidge exactly (HIGH). Diameter GEM '56,10,16' = MEED's '56-inch, 16-inch and 10-inch' (same set, reorder) - agrees (HIGH); a stray SICIM search snippet said '18-inch' for the third pipe but SICIM's own page says only 'various diameters', so MEED's 16-in (matching GEM) stands. StartYear1 2028 matches the Q4-2028 MGS-3 program completion / SICIM 'completed by 2028' (medium-high).

fills.researcher_notes: Location cluster had no [ref] (MISSING_REF) and only country recorded. Package 14 is explicitly the 'Shoaiba cluster' of laterals (MEED, verifier-confirmed 'Shoaiba' + '212'); adds EndLocation=Shoaiba plus the Location ref. Start endpoint left blank - laterals branch off the MGS trunk at multiple internal tie-ins, no single named start point is sourced. Province left blank to avoid guessing (Shoaiba/Ash Shuaybah sits in Makkah Province, but the cited sources say only 'Shoaiba area/cluster'; reviewer may add Makkah as basic geography).
Capacity left blank deliberately. Sources give only the system-wide MGS-3 uplift (~3.15-3.2 bscfd) with no per-line throughput for the Shoaiba laterals; assigning a number would be fabrication.

status_reviews.researcher_notes: Status 'construction' still correct. Package 14 (Nesma/SICIM, Shoaiba) EPC contract was awarded mid-2024; SICIM lists it under 'in progress' (news item 2024-07-29) with completion by 2028, and BlackRidge reports MGS-3 on-site construction activities commenced as of January 2025 toward a Q4-2028 program completion target. No independent evidence the Shoaiba laterals have entered service or been shelved/cancelled. Most recent independent dated evidence ~2025-01 (BlackRidge on-site commencement); this is slightly older than the sheet's 2025-08 LastUpdated but consistent with it and far inside any dormancy threshold on an actively-building program. Not stale, no status change. Note: the L&T 56-inch completion (Pipeline Journal 2025-09) is Package 8, a different corridor, so not cited here as route-specific evidence for Package 14.

summary: P6734 CONFIRMED (caveat): real + uniquely = Aramco MGS-3 Package 14 Shoaiba laterals (MEED+SICIM+BlackRidge, HIGH); 212 km & 56/16/10-in match exactly; Owner Aramco correct; not a duplicate; status=construction confirmed to ~2025-01. Caveat: Aramco calls it 'lateral pipelines' vs GEM PipelineType=transmission (defensible - trunk-fed laterals to Shoaiba load centre). Filled EndLocation=Shoaiba + Location ref.
